newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Sterling Elec EPS view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Sterling Elec EPS view cut.

text.p: --EVEREN Securities Inc said Tuesday it decreased its EPS estimate on Sterling Electronics Inc for FY97 to $1.35 from $1.50. It also cut its FY96 EPS estimate to $1.57 from $1.69.
--"We are basing our EPS estimate revisions on lower anticipated revenue growth for the next three quarters of FY97," said EVEREN in a report.
--EVEREN also cut its six-month price target to $11.50 from $13 and its 18-month price target to $14 from $15.
